defaults.unspecified_preconditions: All other config/acquisition/binding/state/current-root/policy/resource preconditions valid. Fixtures use temporary LAB_TEST data and generated test keys only.

defaults.capacity: Cases at maximum bounds assume adequate OS resources; lower OS capacity is reported unavailable, never promised.
